summary: All 5 UI/UX issues have been verified as FIXED. Tested promo popup behavior, AnimatedModals, PiP button, Profile/Notifications page layouts, and Search modal size on desktop.
passed_tests: Issue 1: Promo popup does NOT appear on initial page load - requires scroll (400px) AND 5+ seconds
Issue 2: LogoutConfirmModal (AnimatedModal) is used in ProfilePage with animated waving hand emoji
Issue 3: PiP button is visible in video player controls when browser supports it
Issue 4: Profile page uses 2-column grid layout on desktop (lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2)
Issue 4: Notifications page uses 2-3 column grid layout on desktop (lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3)
Issue 5: Search modal is smaller on desktop (lg:max-h-[500px] lg:w-[600px]) - centered and constrained
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 UI/UX issues from user feedback have been fixed and verified: 1) Promo popup now requires scroll+time engagement, 2) AnimatedModals are used for logout and milestone claiming, 3) PiP button visible in video player, 4) Profile and Notifications pages have multi-column layouts on desktop, 5) Search modal is smaller on desktop. Splash screen takes ~2.5 seconds to dismiss - use sessionStorage.setItem('kona_splash_shown', 'true') to skip it in tests.

issue_1_promo_popup.details: Promo popup requires scroll (400px) AND 5+ seconds on page before showing. No popup on initial load.

issue_2_animated_modals.details: LogoutConfirmModal shows animated waving hand emoji (👋) with 'Goodbye!' message. ClaimRewardModal available for milestone claiming.

issue_3_pip_support.details: PiP button visible in video player controls on right side. Shows 'PiP' label and PictureInPicture2 icon.

issue_4_profile_layout.details: Profile page uses lg:grid lg:grid-cols-2 lg:gap-6 for 2-column layout on desktop.

issue_4_notifications_layout.details: Notifications page uses grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 for multi-column layout.

issue_5_search_modal.details: Search modal uses lg:h-auto lg:max-h-[500px] lg:w-[600px] lg:mx-auto lg:mt-4 lg:rounded-2xl for smaller desktop size.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real - no mocking
